title: Child of the Universe
about: “I am as old as the universe — I've been here before and I'll be here again — I am a child of the universe, a part of all women and a part of all men.” A big-bang story-song printed in eight books of the collection. Words & music: Theo Simon of Seize The Day (UK), from their 1998 debut — often learned from Melita Silberstein's 2009 recording, hence the “Melita” credit in some songbooks. Sung here by Uri (Budgie) in a dedicated recording for the Rainbow Caravan songbook: Uri (Budgie) — Child of the Universe, Rainbow Caravan Songbook Collection 1 (song #37; song starts past the spoken introduction).
